population: the 74 confirmed-unreachable rows from C37: 37 Sleep Talk, 37 not

finding_1_sleep_talk_is_not_the_mechanis.the_control_c38_should_have_run: the same failure-profile breakdown on the 37 NON-Sleep-Talk unreachable rows
finding_1_sleep_talk_is_not_the_mechanis.reading: Indistinguishable. Two claims have to be separated and C38 ran them together: Sleep Talk boundaries are MORE LIKELY to be unreachable (56% vs 33%, which stands from C37), but CONDITIONAL on being unreachable they fail exactly like everything else. Sleep Talk amplifies exposure to a shared defect -- it fans branches, so there are more ways to miss -- without being the defect.
finding_1_sleep_talk_is_not_the_mechanis.consequence: a Sleep-Talk-specific patch is NOT indicated. C38's 'largest identifiable mechanism' framing is withdrawn; it is the largest identifiable MOVE, which is not the same thing.

finding_2_the_engine_does_not_enumerate_.measured: the engine enumerates 1-3 distinct nonzero HP deltas per boundary (median 2), never 16
finding_2_the_engine_does_not_enumerate_.verified_in_source: gen3/damage_calc.rs:39 -- `enum DamageRolls { Average, Min, Max }`. At most three representative rolls by design, for search tractability.
finding_2_the_engine_does_not_enumerate_.why_i_checked_it: this was a candidate unifying explanation for the whole 74: if the engine never enumerates the sim's 16 rolls, 'no branch reaches the observed value' could be a design property rather than a gap, and C37's headline would collapse.

finding_3_but_it_does_not_explain_the_74.test: An Average-roll branch sits at ~92.5% of max damage, so real rolls 85..100 land within 0.919x to 1.081x of it -- +/-8.1%. Anything further than that from EVERY branch cannot be roll collapse.
finding_3_but_it_does_not_explain_the_74.verdict: roll collapse EXCLUDED. C37's 74 confirmed support gaps survive the challenge.
finding_3_but_it_does_not_explain_the_74.note: 66 not 74 -- the 8 with a zero observed delta or no nonzero branch are excluded from a ratio test rather than counted as passing it.

what_the_engine_gap_bucket_actually_look: 74 rows, confirmed unreachable, and heterogeneous: roughly half have every engine branch smaller than observed, a quarter larger, a quarter bracketing it, and one is a turn the engine thinks did not happen. There is no single bug here and no single fix. Objective 4 ranks by rows x search-impact, and on this evidence the honest row term is not '37 Sleep Talk' but a set of small heterogeneous shapes, none yet large enough on its own to justify an engine patch before the search term is measured.
does_not_reach_a_pass: no code changed; unattributed stays at 485
